notes: Deckhand 1.3.0. New Audio page: record voice over to 48 kHz / 16-bit WAV with input selection, live level meter and an on/off input toggle, plus the ElevenLabs Voice Over tool moved here from Edit. Both write to 01_ASSETS > 02_Audio > 01_VO > MMDD and import to a matching bin, with shared Project and File destination settings and an optional drop at the playhead. Adds Open project folder to the Edit page and Frame.IO to Publicis resources. Unifies pulldown styling across the panel and fixes several light-mode fields that rendered too dark.
